text:
sam_cs: Heads-up — Polaris Health is ready to move from sign‑up to active preview. They want a phased feature rollout by org unit and a weekly 15‑min feedback sync during the first 3 weeks. Compliance reqs: audit logs retained 90d. Pilot window target Mar 25–Apr 14. Can we set this up? cc @jordan_se @olivia_success
priya_cs: I have their access list. Two product teams (ClinicalOps, Integrations). Propose cohorts A/B/C by week so we can isolate regressions. I’ll attach CSV to ticket CS-789.
jordan_se: I can owner the feature flags. Quick q — do we want a 10% -> 50% -> 100% canary per cohort? 7‑day cadence seems reasonable. Also need SDK key scoping per cohort.
olivia_success: I’ll run the weekly feedback syncs and create the enablement sheet. Can we get a 15‑min intro w/ the product PM in week 0? @kevin_ce can you join for the CS handoff?
kevin_ce: On it. I’ll draft a renewal-risk scorecard for the pilot: flag if <3 active seats OR <5k tokens/day over rolling 7d. Also create templated outreach for flagged accounts.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag-service v2 -> staged rollout. Details: https://deploys.internal/feature-flag-service/rollouts/176845
sam_cs: Action items: @jordan_se add toggles + scope SDK keys; @priya_cs upload CSV to CS-789; @olivia_success create enablement sheet + calendar invites; @kevin_ce prepare renewal-risk scorecard and outreach templates. I’ll send the intro email to Polaris tomorrow EOD and confirm audit log retention=90d.
jordan_se: Patch ready, sample flag config below: ```env: production
cohorts:
  - name: cohort-A
    percent: 10
  - name: cohort-B
    percent: 50
  - name: cohort-C
    percent: 100
rollout_days: 7
``` Will push to staging and run smoke tests after staging verification.
priya_cs: CSV uploaded to CS-789 (columns: name,email,team,cohort_pref). Added Polaris contact: laura@polarishealth.com. Ping me if there are mismatches.
olivia_success: Enablement sheet created: https://docs.internal/polaris-pilot. I scheduled a 15‑min intro for Mar 25 10:00 PT and added weekly 15‑min feedback slots for the first three weeks. Also configured a short Typeform for week1 feedback: https://t.typeform.com/polaris-week1
kevin_ce: Scorecard draft uploaded: https://sheets.internal/polaris-scorecard. I configured an automated check every Tues morning that will flag low usage and add a followup task in CS-789.
sam_cs: :thumbsup: Great work. Please post a short thread update in #customer-success after week 1 rollout (metrics + any blockers). I’ll sync w/ PM and share next steps with Polaris. Thanks team!
